azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَوْرَتِي وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani ma uwari bihi awrati wa atajammalu bihi fi hayati
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who clothed me with what covers my private parts and with which I beautify myself in my life.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma lakal-hamd, anta kasawtanih, asaluka khayrahu wa khayra ma suniya lah, wa audhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suniya lah
azkar.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
